name: (08) Mytherceria — 3 Advanced — Ascendant Mytherceria: The Grandest Trick

system.description:
Lasombra legend holds that the Kiasyd share a bond with the fae strong enough to call upon the faerie blood tainting their line. The Grandest Trick is that bittersweet legacy: for a few precious hours the Kiasyd draws her faint faerie heritage to the fore, overwhelming the Curse of Caine itself and walking once more as a living mortal.

Spend ten Blood Traits and one or more Willpower Traits and make a Static Mental Challenge (retest Awareness) against a difficulty of fifteen Traits minus your number of Morality Traits. On success you shrug off the Curse at the next sunrise, reverting to your pre-Embrace mortal form and appearance; you keep no vampiric qualities save Fae Sight, hold no Blood Pool, and shed all Traits above human maximums. Your unlife takes on a dreamlike haze (a Static Mental Challenge versus nine Traits recalls specifics), and your aura reads as a faerie's. The effect lasts one hour per Willpower Trait spent, after which you instantly revert, regaining all Traits and Disciplines with a Blood Pool of ten. If you are killed while mortal, you die for good and may never be re-Embraced.
system.duration: One hour per Willpower Trait spent
